title: Fun and motivational
body:

Drink a cup of water early in the day which i usually forget.
Make sure i eat at least one portion of veggies and fruits every day for the past week.
Keep track of my other habits and routines that I’ve been starting on before downloading this app.
I love the motivational quotes that pop up every time i complete a habit.
This app is definitely well thought of in every detail; i only just started and will continue until i reach my goals🥳
